knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 3.2.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. A 95% CI for mean claim size μ is (80, 100). (1) What does this interval claim about μ? (2) Refuse: 'There is a 95% chance the next claim falls in (80, 100)' and 'a CI is the same as a hypothesis test.'
knowledge_checks.body: Retrieve parameter CI reading; refuse prediction and HT conflation.
knowledge_checks.explanation: CI-from-sample targets a parameter with coverage; it is not a prediction interval or a hypothesis test.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) The interval comes from a procedure with 95% coverage for the unknown parameter μ under repeated sampling. (2) Refuse: that is a prediction reading of a future observation, not a parameter CI. A CI estimates a parameter with coverage; a hypothesis test decides between hypotheses.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Reading a CI as a probability for the next observation, or equating CIs with hypothesis tests.
